_about: Every sound effect the game could use. `npm run sfx` checks public/sounds against this list, writes public/sounds/manifest.json (what the game may load: no manifest entry, no request, no 404) and docs/SFX-TRACKER.md. A sound can have up to 3 variants: name.mp3, or name_1.mp3, name_2.mp3, name_3.mp3 (.ogg/.wav/.webm also work). `wired` says whether the game plays it yet. Entries with "ambience": true are place sounds: one slot per look, `<look>-background` with up to three variants (fortress-background_1.mp3 to _3), in public/ambience (not public/sounds). `npm run sfx` writes public/ambience/manifest.json for them.

sounds.name: shuffle
sounds.plays: A deck is shuffled (game start; a stack reshuffled)

sounds.name: deal
sounds.plays: A card is dealt or drawn
sounds.search: card deal, card slide, card draw

sounds.name: card-flip
sounds.plays: A card is revealed (encounter, location, bids)

sounds.name: card-place
sounds.plays: A card is set down: a bid, a companion joining, the location or encounter landing
sounds.search: card place, card put down, card tap on table

sounds.name: card-pickup
sounds.plays: A card is picked up (hover or select in hand)

sounds.name: card-discard
sounds.plays: A card goes to a discard pile

sounds.name: cards-gather
sounds.plays: Cards swept together at the end of a turn

sounds.name: card-fan
sounds.plays: Your hand is dealt or refilled

sounds.name: card-swap
sounds.plays: Two cards exchanged (Maren, Pip, the apple swap)

sounds.name: card-peek
sounds.plays: Looking at the top of a stack (Grukka, Wren)

sounds.name: effect-negative
sounds.plays: Hex: an ability used against a card, forcing, silencing, taking control (up to 3 variants)
sounds.search: energy zap, magic hit dark, curse, electric discharge

sounds.name: effect-positive
sounds.plays: Boon: a bonus for the one who used it (up to 3 variants); also the fallback for the themed sounds below until you add them
sounds.search: magic shimmer, buff, heal chime, holy

sounds.name: effect-insight
sounds.plays: Looking at a stack (Wren, Grukka, Barnaby): a thin, cool chime

sounds.name: effect-draw
sounds.plays: Cards come to you (Tova, Corvin, Sigrun): a soft rushing shimmer
sounds.search: magic whoosh soft, card draw magic

sounds.name: effect-shield
sounds.plays: A counter or shrug-off (Aldric, Brunna): a metallic ward ringing

sounds.name: effect-trade
sounds.plays: Something changes hands (Maren, Pip, the apple swap): a quick two-note swap

sounds.name: ability-ready
sounds.plays: A card of yours can use an ability now (it glows blue and wiggles): a soft two-note chime
sounds.search: soft chime, two note notification, magic ping

sounds.name: ability-used
sounds.plays: An ability card is shown large

sounds.name: ability-countered
sounds.plays: Aldric's counter lands

sounds.name: sabotage
sounds.plays: Another player's ability hits you

sounds.name: your-turn
sounds.plays: Your turn starts (soft chime or bell)

sounds.name: recruit
sounds.plays: A companion joins your party
sounds.search: recruit, party join, small level up

sounds.name: location-claimed
sounds.plays: Someone wins the location

sounds.name: survive
sounds.plays: You survive the encounter

sounds.name: hero-falls
sounds.plays: A hero falls

sounds.name: renown
sounds.plays: Renown increases

sounds.name: game-win
sounds.plays: You win the game

sounds.name: game-lose
sounds.plays: Someone else wins

sounds.name: click
sounds.plays: Buttons (very short and quiet)

sounds.name: notice
sounds.plays: A message pops up

sounds.name: error
sounds.plays: Something was rejected

sounds.name: menu-open
sounds.plays: The music panel, rules or log opens

sounds.name: tavern-background
sounds.plays: Three different short sounds of this place (patrons murmuring, laughter, mugs clinking, a fire settling); one drifts in now and then while the camera is lifted away from the board
sounds.search: tavern ambience, pub crowd murmur, tankard clink
